source_refs.note: Topic 5.5.1.4 Scatterplots (PDF 147-148, printed 144-145). Figure 5.7 is described in the text; the original diagram uses the class activity's data.

blocks.text: Scatterplots show the relationship between two variables: each point is one observation, placed by its two values. A scatterplot of hours studied against exam scores shows whether scores tend to rise with study time.

blocks.prompt: What pattern of points shows a positive relationship?
blocks.explanation: Points that rise from lower left to upper right: as one variable increases, so does the other.

items: Scatterplot: one point per observation; shows relationships such as hours and marks.
